Adrien Broner, also known as “The Problem” or “AB,” is an American professional boxer from Cincinnati, Ohio, who rose to fame for his exceptional boxing talent, flashy personality, entertaining interviews and outspoken antics outside the ring.

Broner became a four-division world champion, capturing titles in the super featherweight, lightweight, light welterweight and welterweight divisions, establishing himself as one of boxing’s most recognizable personalities during the 2010s.

By the age of 26, Broner had already secured world titles in four different weight classes. Throughout his career, he faced some of the biggest names in boxing, including Manny Pacquiao, Marcos Maidana, Shawn Porter and Mikey Garcia. He also developed a close association with Floyd Mayweather Jr., drawing frequent comparisons to the boxing legend. PBC Press Center +1

Outside of boxing, Broner has become an entertainment personality, frequently making headlines for his social media antics, humorous livestreams, unfiltered comments and interactions with celebrities.

Whether it’s boxing, hip-hop culture or his everyday adventures, AB continues to attract attention across social media, with his unpredictable personality regularly producing viral moments.
